$comment: Token pairings that render below WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1) for 12px text in the
shipped palette. Measured in real Chrome against the live application on
2026-10-29 (UAT-readiness Phase 9, finding UI-008) and reproduced from the
declared tokens by src/index.contrast.test.ts, which agrees with Chrome's
own computed ratios to the second decimal.
This is a NO-GROWTH baseline, not an allowlist. index.contrast.test.ts
asserts the computed set equals this file exactly: a new sub-AA pairing
fails, and a pairing that has since been fixed ALSO fails, so the file
cannot go stale. When the palette decision is made, shrink this file in
the same commit as the colour change.
